title: Adagrad Optimizer Step
signature: def adagrad_step(param, grad, state_sum, lr=0.01, eps=1e-10, weight_decay=0.0) -> tuple
hints: Add this step's squared gradient to the accumulator BEFORE you use it.
Each element gets its own step size: lr / (sqrt(state_sum) + eps).
eps goes outside the square root, and weight decay is added to the gradient first.
